The number one is recognized as a dimensionless base quantity.[5] Radians serve as dimensionless units for angular measurements, derived from the universal ratio of 2π times the radius of a circle being equal to its circumference.[6]. Dimensionless quantities play a crucial role serving as parameters in differential equations in various technical disciplines.
